title: Meta's AI Now Builds You Your Own Mini App 📱
description:
Meta just launched Spaces in its Muse app. Describe an idea in chat and Muse builds a custom space for you, like a gift tracker, a wedding planner or a daily word game. Connect your apps and it keeps itself updated with things like new concert dates or price changes.

It is live now wherever Muse is available. What would you build first? Tell us in the comments!

🔔 Follow AI Daily Drop for the newest AI tools and tech news every day.

Source: Meta, "Design the Muse App, Just for You" (November 6, 2026)

#AItools #AInews #Shorts #Meta #MetaAI
